items.title: Actions
items.description: The row of copy, retry and feedback buttons under an answer.

items.title: Attachments
items.description: Files hanging off a message or a composer, as a grid, a row of chips or a list.

items.title: Chain of Thought
items.description: The steps an agent walked through, with search results and images attached to each one.

items.title: Checkpoint
items.description: A point in the conversation to go back to, before the agent changed things.

items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code in an answer, with a copy button, line numbers and a collapse for long snippets.

items.title: Confirmation
items.description: Ask the reader to approve or deny an action before the agent runs it.

items.title: Context

items.title: Conversation
items.description: The scrolling thread that keeps the newest message in view while it streams.

items.title: Inline Citation
